description: This Java class 'PhotoTask' manages photo download and decode tasks within an Android application, implementing interfaces for download and decode methods, handling threading, caching, and resource management.

classes.name: PhotoTask
classes.description: Manages photo download and decoding tasks, handles threading, resource management, and interfaces for image processing within an Android app.

methods.name: PhotoTask
methods.description: Constructor initializing download and decode runnables, and obtaining the PhotoManager instance.

methods.name: initializeDownloaderTask
methods.description: Initializes the task with a PhotoManager, PhotoView, and cache flag, setting URL, weak reference, and target dimensions.

methods.name: getByteBuffer
methods.description: Returns the byte buffer containing image data.

methods.name: recycle
methods.description: Releases resources and clears references to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: getTargetWidth
methods.description: Returns the target width for the image.

methods.name: getTargetHeight
methods.description: Returns the target height for the image.

methods.name: isCacheEnabled
methods.description: Checks if caching is enabled for this task.

methods.name: getImageURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the image.

methods.name: setByteBuffer
methods.description: Sets the byte buffer with image data.

methods.name: handleState
methods.description: Delegates task state handling to PhotoManager.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the decoded Bitmap image.

methods.name: getHTTPDownloadRunnable
methods.description: Returns the Runnable responsible for downloading the image.

methods.name: getPhotoDecodeRunnable
methods.description: Returns the Runnable responsible for decoding the image.

methods.name: getPhotoView
methods.description: Returns the PhotoView associated with this task.

methods.name: getCurrentThread
methods.description: Returns the Thread this task is running on, synchronized on PhotoManager.

methods.name: setCurrentThread
methods.description: Sets the current Thread for this task, synchronized on PhotoManager.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the decoded Bitmap image.

methods.name: setDownloadThread
methods.description: Sets the Thread handling the download.

methods.name: handleDownloadState
methods.description: Converts and delegates download state to PhotoManager.

methods.name: setImageDecodeThread
methods.description: Sets the Thread handling image decoding.

methods.name: handleDecodeState
methods.description: Converts and delegates decode state to PhotoManager.
